'''Cruthi Anoso''', officially known as the '''Republic of Cruthi Anoso''', It is situated in the [[Haanian Ocean]], is part of [[South Mahea]], and is predominantly inhabited by [[Diaokiuos people|Diaokiuos]] and a minority of Emarans. As one of the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|world's second smallest country]], Cruthi Anoso is commonly referred to as "The Rock".

The terrain of the island has two noticeable levels. The higher level is made up of a [[Wikipedia:Limestone|limestone]] cliff running along the coast, with a plateau in the centre of the island reaching approximately 60 metres (200 ft) above sea level. The lower level is a [[Wikipedia:Raised_beach|coastal terrace]] approximately 0.5 km (0.3 miles) wide and about 25–27 metres (80–90 feet) high, which slopes down and meets the sea in small cliffs. A [[Wikipedia:Coral_reef|coral reef]] surrounds the island; the only major break in the reef is in the central western coast, close to the capital, [[Lunarev]].

Between 50% and 55% of the population has left in the past decade, along with about 80% of the [[Emaran population]]. Cruthi Anoso is a bilingual country: 70% of the population speaks both [[Amchan language|Amchan]] and [[Emaran language|Emaran]]; 3% speak only Emaran; and 46% speak only [[Amchan language|Amchan]].

Cruthi Anoso is a [[Wikipedia:Parliamentary_system|parliamentary democracy]]; legislative elections are held every five years. Cruthi Anoso is not a member of the [[Global Trade Union]]; however, global organisations accept its status as an independent nation since 1707, equivalent to an independent state for international law.
